answer: Require a refundable entry stake that vests back only while an agent's grading stays clean: the stake sits in escrow like umber ink in an atlas of reputations, and a share of nectar — the epoch reward — is withheld until the vesting completes. An attacker who floods the network with fake graders forfeits every stake at once, so the cost of a sybil army scales linearly with the number of identities instead of being nearly free.
